syntax: AST parse and compile passed without importing or executing the controller.
delta_review: Below the header, the prior reviewed controller is byte-identical except for stronger per-case CNF and metadata hash bindings.

execution_scope.stdout_stderr: Separate complete exclusive-created files; no truncation or filtering of stored solver output.
execution_scope.signals: SIGTERM/SIGINT set a stop flag; only its own new-session child process group is interrupted and then killed after the grace period if necessary.
execution_scope.sentinel: DESK_ERROR.response prevents starting the next case and stops an active solver on the next one-second poll.
execution_scope.renewal: Invokes the existing job-local renew.py before each case with check=True. The helper was neither read nor executed for this review.
execution_scope.status: Exit 10 or a SAT status stops the portfolio and labels candidate_requires_validation. Exit 20 is recorded only and conveys no accepted UNSAT result.
execution_scope.state: Atomic portfolio JSON updates; fresh output directory required; finalizer stops an active child and saves state.

limitations: Candidate discovery only: all four uncertified UNSAT returns would still not establish exhaustion.
A reported SAT candidate requires the independent original-model validator before any witness claim.
The outer 330-second limit is followed by up to ten seconds of shutdown grace; this is not a 330-second hard kill limit.
